### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Kintera supplies thermodynamics and restart tensor serialization.
Kintera minimum 2.5.13; Harp and Disort required without a version here.
Order: code map; no independent measured convergence order.
No defining equation: this section maps control flow or data ownership.
:::

Kintera supplies thermodynamics and restart tensor serialization. Harp supplies the integrator constructed by the
MeshBlock. Python imports pyharp and pydisort as well as kintera; those imports are not a radiation operator inside
the hydro pipeline.

### Derivation

No separate derivation: this section describes an interface or control-flow path. Numerical operators are derived in
their owning chapters.

### Numerical method

The dependency boundary is visible at creation, stage adjustment and restart IO call sites. The report derives the
propagation of supplied stage weights, but their selection and the stop predicate live in the external integrator.
Build metadata pins torch 2.10.0 for the build and declares Linux commux and pinc requirements. Runtime version
requirements must be read separately. Appendix E owns external-component equations and full version analysis.

@fig-ch01-dependencies-flow shows the data or call sequence.

### Limits

No dependency integration run is supplied here. Harp stage coefficients cannot be justified by a snapy line alone. The
kintera minimum is tied in the CMake comments to the saturation-failure counter used by redo. Radiation functionality
in dependencies is outside this chapter and outside the seven-section hydro call map.
